description: A greenfield healthcare rewards platform, taken from scratch to pilot in six months by four engineers. I own the member experience on iOS and Android and the backend and authentication underneath it. Promoted from Full Stack Software Engineer to Senior in April 2026.
highlights: Own all six member journeys on iOS and Android: screens, Auth0 PKCE authentication, and the backend wiring behind each
Built the backend layer on a low-code graph platform: 57 of 159 endpoints, plus the deploy pipeline, drift detection against the live cluster, and CI test gates
Converged the platform onto a single Next.js BFF from two interim edges across five phases, verified by a route-parity suite (283 files, +6,971 / −26,130 lines)
Built the fitness tracker integration end to end: selected the wearable aggregator and wrote the ADR; signed-webhook ingestion credits rewards through the loyalty ledger in ~3.5 seconds
Took authentication from demo-grade to production on web and mobile, with verified identity linking across parent and child orgs and member identity derived server-side from the credential
Reviewed 274 teammates' pull requests in five months; onboarded a principal engineer and handed off mobile build and release ownership

Prior project, a rewards app for a Fortune 500 health client: owned a complex eligibility feature end to end three months after joining. It was scoped as minor UI work; I delivered it full stack, through the backend and business logic, against a hard year-end deadline
1st of 20 teams, North American AI Hackathon (sole engineer) · Rookie of the Year 2026
